title: Refresh TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE 4.1 and 4.3 to describe the owner runtime
description:
Sections 4.1 and 4.3 still read as host-worker design for own-account computers. Rewrite to the built owner path; customer accounts keep the host protocol.

What remains (triage 2026-10-14): Sections 4.1, 4.2 and 4.3 of docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md now open with status notes that the host worker and the nine routes are the customer-account path and that own-account computers run a Pi owner (PR 488). Left: the 4.1 status paragraph still says the owner 'exits' and 'one owner runs per computer at a time'; it should describe the long-lived supervisor (poll protocol, idle timeout, per-turn child) from Phase 2a, and the file view/edit path, with links to docs/LONG_LIVED_COMPUTER.md, docs/OWNER_SUPERVISOR_PROTOCOL.md and docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md. Small, docs only.
